$comment: Launchpad-UI test fund. Identical to testnet-dev EXCEPT the launchpad window, which is SEVEN
DAYS instead of 1 hour so the dApp's launchpad screens can be exercised against a fund that
is actually in `Initialized` rather than one that closed minutes after deploy.
Window raised from 2 days to 7 on the 1.3.0 redeploy (2026-09-12). The 1.2.0 demo fund was
deployed 2026-09-10 with a 2-day window and expired on the 12th -- it ran out before the FE
work that needed it did, which is the whole failure this fund exists to avoid.
RECORDED IN config/deployments.json, BUT WITH "opsDefault": false. The entry is what makes BE
index the fund -- without one a holder's launchpad deposit is invisible in the dApp, which is
the whole reason this fund exists. The flag is what stops it hijacking the CLI: `readDeployment`
otherwise picks the newest `deployedAt` for a network, and this fund is deployed AFTER the
operational one. Set the flag BY HAND after `post-deploy` -- nothing writes it for you. Operate
REGISTRY CAVEAT: the registry keys by the rwaToken address (REXRegistry._validateAndKey), not
by wrwaRoute as ADR-021 worded it. This fund shares rwaToken 0x5d5c787e with the operational
one, so registering it makes it a NEW VERSION of the SAME fund. latestOf is the tail of the
chain and BE resolves latestOfToken, so whichever is registered LAST is what the dApp shows.
Reversible: unregister clears the fund record, so removing this one leaves 1.2.0 current.
SC13 §4.2: pruvExecutor.redeemDelay (and minRedeemDelay) must stay below epochDuration - schedule.windowLength.

rexPrimary.$comment: launchpadPeriod 604800 = 7 days. launchpadMinimum must stay >= minSub or the ctor reverts InvalidLaunchpadConfig.
